svg.title: Baffin Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 1200 km. Summer western-Baffin-Bay external coastal reference reach between OSW gates near the source-observed Lady Ann Strait latitude (76 N) and Cape Dyer latitude (67 N). Omits the Lancaster Sound intrusion and return, upstream Arctic strait feeders, transient eddies and continuation through southern Davis Strait. Source says at least these latitude limits; they are not whole-current endpoints. Exact offshore vertices are OSW choices, not a digitized observed trajectory. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate Baffin summer external coastal reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 54 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Fissel et al. (1982), pp. 180/183; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
